subject: Interactive Graphs that recognize user actions (such as a double click).

messages.author: fd8a0dda7135a21d
messages.subject: Interactive Graphs that recognize user actions (such as a double click).
parts:
I am developing a shiny application that includes graphs created using the googlevis package. I am using the shiny dashboard package (http://rstudio.github.io/shinydashboard/index.html) and all the graphs I am using are on different tabs. I would like to connect these graphs so that a user can navigate between them by making selections on the graph.

As a specific example, I have a line graph where each line represents a customer in the data set. I want to be able to click on a line representing a customer and this action will open a new graph that shows all items purchased by the customer, each line representing an item. 

If this cannot be done in googlevis, I am open to using another package in R that will work with Shiny.
